title: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings to Announce Third Quarter 2025 Earnings on October 22, 2025
summary: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings (NYSE: ASIC) (the “Company”) announced today that it will release financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2025, after the market closes on Wednesday, October 22, 2025. These documents will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website at https://investors.ategrity.com . The Company will host a conference call to discuss its results on the same day, Wednesday, October 22, 2025, beginning at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Interested parties may access the conference call via a live webcast, which can be accessed at https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/973718107 or by visiting the Company’s Investor Relations website. Please join the webcast at least 10 minutes before the scheduled start time. A replay of the event webcast will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website approximately two hours following the call, for a period of at least 30 days.
